title: alnus alnobetula subsp. fruticosa
intro: Alnus alnobetula subsp. fruticosa, commonly known as the Mountain Alnus or Green Alder, is a subspecies of deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The Mountain Alnus is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. Its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, soothe skin irritations, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the Mountain Alnus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
